text:
Ana (Marketing): Quick one — City Circuits Reykjavik checklist. Need final swag counts, speaker confirmations, freight ETA + customs docs, slide review deadline, and inbound lead routing for the post-event webinar. Who can own each?

Jordan (Growth): I can take lead routing + post-event webinar nurture. I updated the routing sheet: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-iceland-leads. Need tag rules (interest, demo, enterprise).

Sasha (Logistics): Freight update: carrier confirmed but customs needs contact. AWB AF-ICL-00987, ETA 2025-07-22 09:00 local. Will request hold-release to the venue. I also need final weights for the promo crates by Thu.

Mike (Events): Booth staffing draft in the sheet — 2 shifts per day, 3 people on demo desk. Can we lock who on demo for the 3pm-6pm prime slot?

Lisa (Product): Speaker confirmations: 5 talks accepted, 3 still pending slides. I asked the speakers to submit slides by 2025-07-18. Can we do a quick content review the 19th?

Ana (Marketing): Owners: swag counts -> Jordan, freight/customs -> Sasha, staffing -> Mike, slides/review -> Lisa, lead routing & webinar -> Jordan. Agree?

Jordan (Growth): Agree. For lead tags, propose: "webinar_invite", "enterprise_followup", "demo_now". We'll wire that into the QR -> sheet mapping. Also plan a 1:1 touch for high intent leads within 48h.

Sasha (Logistics): Shipping manifest snippet (will paste into shared drive):
```
Item,Qty,Dimensions,Weight(kg)
Booth crate A,1,120x80x40,85
Booth crate B,1,120x80x40,90
Promo box stickers,10,40x30x20,15
Promo box tees,5,60x40x40,40
Promo box socks,3,50x30x30,20
```
Need dims confirmed. Also heads-up: venue requires commercial invoice + VAT proforma for customs, email me the invoice contact.

Mike (Events): Staffing notes: please add one floater for overflow demos (Fri evening). Also want to reserve a quiet room for 30-min speaker prep and a small table for customer 1:1 calls. Who can reserve with venue?

Sasha (Logistics): I can book the prep room; will confirm by EOD. For the courier, prefer local pickup on 7/21 to avoid morning congestion.

Lisa (Product): Slide review: set calendar invite for 7/19 10:00-11:30 (internal reviewers: Lisa, Ana, Mike). I'll annotate slides for product claims and demo scripts. Speakers — please do not add pricing screenshots.

Ana (Marketing): Swag counts — Jordan, what are recommended final numbers? We have ~800 registrants expected, add 20% buffer?

Jordan (Growth): Proposed final order: stickers 1200, tees 320 (S-XL mix), pins 600, socks 160, promo postcards 900, laptop stickers (limited) 250. If budget tight, deprioritize socks.

Mike (Events): Agree on buffer. Also order 2 extra demo kits (laptop + mics) as backups.

raffle-bot: :tada: Reminder: raffle prize list needed for onsite signup. Please DM Jordan with prizes.

Sasha (Logistics): Customs contact: Reykjavik Customs requires importer EORI on the commercial invoice. Ana — can you confirm Redwood's importer code or should we use our local partner?

Ana (Marketing): Use local partner — I'll PM procurement for the importer EORI and loop Sasha.

Jordan (Growth): Post-event nurture plan: 3-step sequence — thank you + on-demand demo (24h), case study + invite to webinar (72h), personal AE outreach (5 days) for demo_now tags. Will draft email templates tomorrow.

Lisa (Product): For speaker prep: share the demo checklist in the talk repo: repo link https://tinyurl.com/redwood-talks-iceland. Add a 5-min product TL;DR slide for each speaker.

Ana (Marketing): Deadline summary: final swag counts by EOD Fri (1755060000), shipping dims by Thu, slides in by 7/18, internal review 7/19, freight pickup 7/21, webinar nurture templates by Mon. I'll send a consolidated runbook after this thread.

Mike (Events): Noted. I'll lock demo leads and floaters once Jordan confirms final headcount.

Jordan (Growth): One ask — can we have a QR for the on-site demo signups that auto-tags based on session selected? I can wire that into the sheet if we create per-session shortcodes.

Sasha (Logistics): For the QR stickers on the desk, we need print-ready artwork by 7/14. Designer — ping when ready.

Ana (Marketing): Thanks team. If no objections I'll post this plan to the event runbook and create tasks in Asana. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Growth): Good plan. I'll start templates and the lead mapping tonight.

Lisa (Product): I'll start slide reviews as they come in.

Sasha (Logistics): I'll confirm courier pickup time and exporter docs by tomorrow morning.

Mike (Events): I'll finalize the staffing rota.

Ana (Marketing): Closing note — let's keep replies short in this thread; use the runbook for granular updates. See you on the 7/19 review. :rocket:
